title: tulipa clusiana f. cashmeriana
intro: Tulipa clusiana f. cashmeriana, commonly known as Shirley's Cottage Pink or Lady Mary, is a rare and exquisite variety of the Tulipa clusiana species, which is a type of wild tulip native to Europe. This plant is known for its delicate, pink or white flowers with distinctive red or yellow markings. The health benefits of Tulipa clusiana f. cashmeriana are not extensively documented, but it is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. However, the primary therapeutic actions are related to its ornamental and medicinal uses, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including tulipalin, which has been shown to have antimicrobial and antiviral properties, although further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.
